facts.fact: The World Bank aide-memoire for the mission of 3-7 June 2024 records that a consulting firm 'has been developing' the South Sudan Digital Development Road Map/Master Plan and supporting the Government to prepare its future digital development strategy, having held private-sector and public-sector consultations on draft recommendations; no adopting act or body is named, and the document does not describe the Road Map's scope, so class is left empty.
